description:
Australian advertising & marketing compliance for AI assistants. Scan websites, check ad/social/email copy, and look up regulator guidelines (ACCC, TGA, ASIC, AHPRA, ACMA) directly from Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor.

Tools:

- `scan_website_compliance` — audit any public URL for AU advertising risk
- `check_ad_copy` — analyse ad, social, or email copy for regulatory issues
- `get_compliance_guidelines` — look up rules by industry & jurisdiction

Free tier: 20 scans / 40 ad checks / 60 guideline lookups per IP per hour. Indicative results only — not legal advice.

Built by [Anchor Compliance](https://anchorcompliance.io).

tool_signatures.name: check_ad_copy
tool_signatures.description: Analyses ad, social, or email copy for potential regulatory risk under Australian advertising law. Returns risk level, flagged phrases, and indicative suggested edits. Indicative only — not legal advice.

content.description: The ad copy, social post, or email body to analyse

industry.description: Industry context: healthcare, gambling, financial-services, automotive, real-estate, insurance, legal, general

tool_signatures.name: get_compliance_guidelines
tool_signatures.description: Returns a summary of advertising and marketing compliance guidelines for a given industry and jurisdiction (e.g. healthcare in AU, gambling in NSW). Indicative summary only — always cross-check with the cited source.

industry.description: Industry: healthcare, gambling, financial-services, automotive, real-estate, insurance, legal

platform.description: Optional platform filter: web, social, email, broadcast

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction code (default: AU). State codes accepted: NSW, VIC, QLD, etc.

tool_signatures.name: rewrite_content_compliant
tool_signatures.description: Rewrites ad, social, email, or web copy into a lower-risk, more compliant version under Australian advertising law. Returns the rewritten copy, a list of changes made, and (optionally) suggested disclaimers. Indicative only — not legal advice. Always have a qualified compliance professional review before publishing.

content.description: The ad, social post, email, or web copy to rewrite into a lower-risk, compliant version

industry.description: Industry context: healthcare, gambling, financial-services, automotive, real-estate, insurance, legal, general

add_disclaimers.description: If true, append suggested disclaimers/compliance clauses (default: true)

tool_signatures.name: scan_website_compliance
tool_signatures.description: Scans a public website URL for potential advertising and marketing compliance issues across Australian regulatory frameworks (ACCC, TGA, ASIC, AHPRA, ACMA). Returns an indicative risk score, top issues found, and a link to the full report. Indicative only — not legal advice.

url.description: Public URL of the website or page to scan (e.g. https://example.com)

industry.description: Optional industry: healthcare, gambling, financial-services, automotive, real-estate, insurance, legal
